Class SimulationController.DemandManager

java.lang.Object
controller.SimulationController.DemandManager
Enclosing class:
SimulationController
public class SimulationController.DemandManager extends Object
The DemandManager class is responsible for managing the yearly demand for different types of cargo including people, mail, coal, iron, and steel. It tracks delivery quantities, adjusts demand levels based on delivery performance, and incorporates modifications from historical scenarios.

    • updateYearlyDemand

      public void updateYearlyDemand(Scenario scenario)
      Updates the yearly demand for different types of commodities and applies scenario-specific modifications. The method recalculates demand values based on the yearly deliveries and adjusts them according to the rules defined in the scenario. It also resets the yearly delivery counts and displays a summary of the demand update.
      Parameters:
      scenario - the scenario used to determine modifications to demand based on historical restrictions
